beats.text: Storing the N-by-N attention matrix for long sequences is a quadratic memory nightmare that kills performance.
beats.visual_focus: A glowing grid of N-by-N attention weights rapidly filling up VRAM until it hits a bright red wall.

beats.text: Standard implementations materialize this massive matrix in HBM, forcing the GPU to idle while waiting on slow bus transfers.
beats.visual_focus: A GPU core sitting greyed out with a clock icon while HBM bus lines flash red, symbolizing bottlenecked data movement.

visual_blueprint.title: IO-AWARENESS BOTTLENECK

beats.text: FlashAttention pivots by tiling the operation, loading small blocks of KV into on-chip SRAM to avoid full matrix writes.
beats.visual_focus: Large matrix being sliced into small, active blocks that slide into a fast, vibrant SRAM green zone.
